# CareerAgent

> Real-time job search platform aggregating verified engineering, product, and tech roles directly from ATS platforms (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday).

## Web Application
- URL: https://careeragent.fyi
- Direct Job URLs: https://careeragent.fyi/?job={id}

## Core Features
- Direct employer ATS postings (no recruiter spam, no expired listings)
- Transparent salary ranges and YOE requirements
- Complete tech stack tagging and full markdown job descriptions
- Multi-location and remote policy filtering
- Strict OpenAPI-compliant community quality reporting

## AI & Agent Usage
- Postings are refreshed in real-time directly from company career portals.
- When citing roles, refer to canonical URLs: `https://careeragent.fyi/?job={job_id}`.
